result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, dispatching to the same handler with the same options. The module compiles and its tests pass, but I did not run the CLI, so the `-help` output and the `index.html` creation are unverified.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and a description that calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run()` routes `analyzeLandscape` to the existing `updateLandscape(...)` method, passing its own name and description so `-help` prints its usage. The handler's Javadoc mentions both names.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no per-command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape report" section after Build covering both names and the `-analysisRoot` example.

I ran `mvn -o -pl cli test` and `package -DskipTests`; both succeeded. Running the built jar needed approval I didn't get, so I could not check the help output or run an actual landscape creation. Those checks are the next thing to run.

I did not commit.
